page.overview:
What is Blindeyes?

The Blindeyes, or Guild of Beggars, was one of the gangs in Novigrad. Led by the King of Beggars, the gang was composed mainly by thieves, smugglers, prostitutes, and beggars; in short every poor citizen who lived in the Bits and in the Lacehalls districts of Novigrad. The gang's revenue came mostly from thefts, pickpockets, and extortions. Their headquarters was located in the Putrid Grove.
